dogecoin.text: If you're selling #dogecoin then you are cutting yourself short for a buck. You obviously are jumping on the media bandwagon and not believing that the coin will continue to rise. #Bitcoin is the first coin of it's kind, but dogecoin is the first "dumb coin", people like dumb.

Don’t buy #dogecoin if you’re going to panic. Everyone has their own thoughts about the coin and the coin as exceeded it’s number and shown people it’s value. If you are going to invest then know your purpose and hold it. Don’t have FOMO there will be other opportunities . #SNL
